_comment: ngsolve nonlinear_elasticity#3 (Variation() autodiff vs hand-coded P / dP/dF). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the hand-coded PK1 matches Variation()'s residual to ~6e-15; a tangent linearised from a P whose mu term is doubled turns 5 residual evaluations into 39 with |r_k+1|/|r_k| pinned at a constant ~0.55 (linear) while still reaching the same solution; the matched tangent is quadratic. Correction to the claim: using the factor-2 P for BOTH residual and tangent stays quadratic (6 steps) but converges to a wrong displacement, because NGSolve differentiates whatever residual form it is given -- the linear signature needs an inconsistent tangent, not a wrong P.
